title: Dovet — Keep the work. Change the agent. | Agents for Humans
description_lines: Dovet is a local-first recovery supervisor for interrupted, explicitly managed coding-agent work.

This film demonstrates the working local product: a real managed Codex interruption, immutable checkpoint and byte-identical restore, durable local service, deterministic authorization controls, portable recovery, and independent verification design.

AWS account provisioning blocked every Bedrock text-model invocation before the deadline. Cloud-dependent scenes are visibly labelled. The Strands recovery integration is implemented, but this build records zero successful provider requests and does not claim a live Bedrock recovery or AgentCore deployment.
Built for Agents for Humans — Professional Agents.

The fixture code and UI replay are synthetic. The interruption and checkpoint evidence are real. The opening visual and neutral American synthetic narration were produced with Higgsfield; product footage comes from the working Dovet application.
